Choose something they will actually use

Start with an interest they already spend time on. Then check what they own: a controller must support their gaming system, a craft kit should match their experience, and a book should be one they have not already read. A lower-cost gift that fits is more useful than an expensive duplicate.

Leave room in your budget for shipping and tax. The bands below estimate gift types rather than promise current listing prices. Confirm the seller’s price, delivery date, and return policy before you order.
